calib_14_GramE_attribution_loop.error_span_in_summary: the speaker argues that the speaker argues that the speaker argues that the speaker posits
calib_14_GramE_attribution_loop.source_evidence: The speaker argues that the speaker posits that effortless achievement can be understood
calib_14_GramE_attribution_loop.brief_rationale: Self-attribution loop: 'X argues that X argues that X argues that...' Repeated speaker-attribution clause corrupts the proposition's grammatical scope. Classic YouTube-transcript GramE regression.
